name: immichFrame
description: immichFrame is a digital photo frame application that interfaces with your immich server. This project is not affiliated with immich!

paths.name: immichFrame Config
paths.description: LEAVE EMPTY IF YOU ARE USING THE OTHER VARIABLES - immichFrame Config-Folder, should contain a Settings.json, more informations here: https://github.com/immichFrame/ImmichFrame#settingsjson

variables.name: ImmichServerUrl
variables.description: The URL of your Immich server e.g. https://photos.yourdomain.com or http://192.168.0.100:2283

variables.name: ApiKey
variables.description: Your immich API-Key (https://immich.app/docs/features/command-line-interface/#obtain-the-api-key)

variables.name: Albums
variables.description: immich album UUIDs, comma ',' separated

variables.name: ExcludedAlbums
variables.description: UUID of excluded album(s)

variables.name: People
variables.description: UUID of person(s)

variables.name: ShowMemories
variables.description: If this is set, memories are displayed.

variables.name: ImagesFromDays
variables.description: Show images from the last X days. e.g 365 -> show images from the last year.

variables.name: ImagesFromDate
variables.description: Show images after date. Overwrites the ImagesFromDays-Setting

variables.name: ImagesUntilDate
variables.description: Show images before date.

variables.name: ImageZoom
variables.description: Zooms into or out of an image and gives it a touch of life.

variables.name: Interval (seconds)
variables.description: Image interval in seconds. How long a image is displayed in the frame.

variables.name: TransitionDuration (seconds)
variables.description: Duration in seconds.

variables.name: WeatherApiKey
variables.description: Get api-key: OpenWeatherMap (https://openweathermap.org/).

variables.name: UnitSystem
variables.description: Imperial or metric system. (Fahrenheit or degrees)

variables.name: Language
variables.description: 2 digit ISO code, sets the language of the weather description.

variables.name: ShowWeatherDescription
variables.description: Displays the description of the current weather.

variables.name: WeatherLatLong
variables.description: Set the weather location with lat/lon.

variables.name: ShowClock
variables.description: Displays the current time.

variables.name: ClockFormat
variables.description: Time format.

variables.name: Webcalendars
variables.description: A list of webcalendar URIs in the .ics format. e.g. https://calendar.google.com/calendar/ical/XXXXXX/public/basic.ics

variables.name: ShowImageDesc
variables.description: Displays the description of the current image.

variables.name: ShowPeopleDesc
variables.description: Displays a comma separated list of names of all the people that are assigned in immich.

variables.name: ShowImageLocation
variables.description: Displays the location of the current image.

variables.name: ShowPhotoDate
variables.description: Displays the date of the current image.

variables.name: PhotoDateFormat
variables.description: Date format. See https://date-fns.org/v4.1.0/docs/format for more information.

variables.name: PrimaryColor
variables.description: Lets you choose a primary color for your UI. Use hex with alpha value to edit opacity.

variables.name: SecondaryColor
variables.description: Lets you choose a secondary color for your UI. (Only used with style=solid or transition) Use hex with alpha value to edit opacity.

variables.name: Style
variables.description: Background-style of the clock and metadata.

variables.name: Layout
variables.description: Allow two portrait images to be displayed next to each other

variables.name: BaseFontSize
variables.description: Sets the base font size, uses standard CSS formats (https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/font-size).
